summary: iter-88 H2H player-prop AVG suppression + three-card redesign + preview health: ALL PASS. Backend suite (test_iter88_player_prop_avg_suppression.py: 8/8) — MLB player-prop chips carry NO 'avg' substring, MLB team-market chips DO carry 'avg runs', Soccer player-prop chips carry NO 'avg', deep-dive /api/picks/{id}/h2h returns is_player_prop=true for a Hits pick and is_player_prop=false for a team spread, no 5xx on invalid pick id, iter-82 same-line O/U regression still clean. FRONTEND Playwright on public preview: demo login → Locks board rendered 146 pick-cards and 57 h2h-chips; sampled 30 chip texts and only 1 contains 'avg' (that one is a Yankees +1.5 SPREAD → correctly labelled 'H2H 2-3 L5 · 9.8 avg runs'), remaining 29 are player-prop chips of form 'H2H X-Y LZ' with NO avg — matches the spec exactly. HITS deep-dive (Riley Greene DET Over 0.5 Hits): h2h-panel present, GAME-DAY H2H card renders in AMBER bg rgb(254,243,199) — matches #FEF3C7 amber-100 spec — and the AVG cell is CORRECTLY HIDDEN (team stats row shows only RECORD 4-5 + MEETINGS 9). SPREAD deep-dive (NYY +1.5): AVG RUNS cell IS present (value 9.8). Preview URL health OK: no white screen, no 5xx, board renders normally. Regression: iter-86 contract 6/6 + iter-87 5/6 still pass (2 unrelated env issues — cold cache latency 36s on iter-86 perf test and a data-availability skip on iter-87 soccer H2H, neither is a regression from iter-88). Note: on the HITS deep-dive the BLUE player-matchup card did NOT render because MLB batter-vs-pitcher H2H is intentionally NOT wired in _mlb_player_h2h (only pitcher props are covered — see h2h_enricher.py:266-273 comment). This is by design per the code. If E1 wants a BLUE player card on batter props, mlb_hr_intel data would need to be surfaced via player_h2h — flagging as an observation.

issues: No BLUE 'PLAYER MATCHUP' sub-card rendered for a batter-Hits pick. h2h-panel shows only the AMBER game-day card + situational card.
